admission.license_interpretation: Exact mirror LICENSE.md is evidence of a mirror claim, not independent verification of original reuse permission.
admission.parent_road_session_sequence: unknown; filename integer is not a verified parent or adjacent-frame group
admission.negative_policy: Empty test JSON is unannotated, never an intact negative; empty train JSON needs human review.
remaining_gates: Original-release identity and reuse rights verification
Human review of at least 50 varied image/overlay pairs
Near-duplicate and original-source ancestry checks including RDD2020
Road/session/adjacent-frame grouping and frozen independent Indian evaluation split
Human-reviewed masks for precise extent; boxes are localization only
Reviewed intact negatives and surface-domain coverage
prohibited_inferences: masks or precise area from boxes
